input.quote: 18.2 Policies will be issued by reputable insurers and be primary to Customer's insurance where commercially customary. On request, Vendor shall provide certificates of insurance and evidence of relevant coverage.
input.rationale: Section 18 already meets our preferred insurance position: § 18.1 requires CGL of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, professional errors and omissions of USD 2,000,000, cyber and privacy liability of USD 5,000,000 (unconditional, so it covers Vendor's processing of Customer Data), and workers' compensation as required by law, maintained throughout the term and one year afterward. Section 18.2 supplies certificates of insurance on request. Every preferred element is satisfied and the surrounding insurer-quality, cancellation-notice and non-limitation terms favour us, so no redline is warranted.
